result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_all_connected_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get all nodes reachable from the specified node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L20124-L20216){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_all_connected_nodes(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses breadth-first search (BFS) to find all nodes in the same connected component. For directed graphs, treats edges as undirected during traversal. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Starting node ID (int) or label (str) for the search. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of all reachable node IDs, excluding the starting node itself. Empty list if the node is isolated. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `node=` does not exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a graph made of two disconnected path components, nodes reachable from one component never include nodes from the other: ::: {#11a82ce6 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_path_graph(3) # First component: 3 nodes graph.add_path_graph(2) # Second component: 2 more nodes node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) connected = graph.get_all_connected_nodes(node_ids[0]) # Returns 2 (the other two nodes in the same component) len(connected) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#89638897 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Starting from the second component gives a completely different set connected_other = graph.get_all_connected_nodes(node_ids[3]) # Returns 1 (just the one other node in that component) len(connected_other) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: Repeating this for every unvisited node is a simple way to enumerate all connected components and their sizes: ::: {#f258427a .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} visited = set() components = [] for node_id in graph.get_node_ids(limit=None): if node_id not in visited: component = graph.get_all_connected_nodes(node=node_id) component.append(node_id) # Include the starting node itself components.append(component) visited.update(component) # Returns 2 components len(components) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
